method: POST-HOC TRANSPARENT AUDIT; not preregistered, not intended as calibrated clinical efficacy probability

gate_definitions.DE: D02 FDR<0.05 AND D02 log2FC>0; no magnitude threshold
gate_definitions.human: missing or low CPM flagged, NEVER presumed no stroke expression
gate_definitions.topology: source screening categories; NOT measured blood-facing access
gate_definitions.mechanism: full-text adjudicated only for five + benchmark; experimental direction and cargo identity explicitly separated
gate_definitions.safety: noncompensatory review and experiments; no toxicity probability estimated

quant_priority.formula: weighted mean of empirical percentiles of logFC, human brain EC CPM, EC/nonEC log2, extracellular identity; missing metrics omitted and coverage reported; not a final rank
quant_priority.caveat: No paper-count popularity boost; no compensation for wrong transport direction, nonluminal protein or serious safety

selection_caveat: PROCR and TM4SF1 are working choices for computational feasibility; expert/luminal binding/wet-lab gate required before experimental or clinical selection
all_candidates_fulltext: Only 5/125 discovery candidates were reviewed at full-text level; counterfactual candidates from pass1 must not be described as experimentally rejected
